findings.passage: Every eligible Arizonan deserves the freedom to vote easily, securely, and with confidence that their ballot will be counted. I will continue fighting against efforts that make it harder for eligible voters to participate in our democracy while supporting policies that strengthen both election access and election integrity. That includes protecting Arizona's popular Vote-by-Mail system, expanding early voting opportunities, supporting same-day voter registration with appropriate verification requirements, and ensuring election officials have the resources they need to administer safe, secure, and transparent elections.
findings.note: Campaign priorities page, elections section. Undated page. She names mail voting, early voting and same-day registration with verification requirements; it does not mention photo ID or proof of citizenship by name.

findings.passage: I am committed to combating voter suppression efforts and advocating for policies that enhance accessibility to voting, including preserving Vote By Mail and advocating for Same Day Registration on Election Day with proper proof of residency and citizenship. These measures will uphold election integrity while ensuring all Arizonans can exercise their right to vote.
findings.note: Candidate issue statement on the BallotReady voter guide, written in the first person. Undated. She links same-day registration to proof of residency and citizenship.
